name.la: Actus beati Francisci et sociorum eius
name.en-US: The Deeds of Blessed Francis and His Companions (Actus)
name.pt-BR: Os Feitos do bem-aventurado Francisco e seus companheiros (Actus)

description.la: Actus beati Francisci et sociorum eius (c. 1328-1337), fons latinus Fiorettorum: capita I-LXVIII (quae in fonte exstant; cap. LXIX-LXXVI desunt) de Francisco, de fratribus Bernardo, Egidio, Iuniperio, Massaeo et aliis, de stigmatibus Alvernae.
description.en-US: The Deeds of Blessed Francis and His Companions (c. 1328-1337), the Latin source of the Fioretti: stories of Francis and of Brothers Bernard, Giles, Juniper, Masseo and others, ending with the stigmata at La Verna. The Fioretti (a separate book here) is its Italian reworking, with a different set of chapters. Latin only. The source carries chapters I to LXVIII; chapters LXIX to LXXVI of the complete work are not in it.
description.pt-BR: Os Feitos do bem-aventurado Francisco e seus companheiros (c. 1328-1337), a fonte latina dos Fioretti.

la.editor: transcription by M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari; edition not stated

sources.edition: Actus beati Francisci et sociorum eius, poliba.it "Fonti francescane" (Wayback Machine snapshot).
sources.description: Chapters I to LXVIII, the whole of the Wayback snapshot (the page has two parts; the second starts at LXV and is kept in sequence). Chapters LXIX-LXXVI of the complete work (Sabatier 1902, archive.org actusbeatifranc00sabagoog) are not on this source. Latin only.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval text. The transcription (M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari, Biblioteca di Scienze del Cristianesimo, 2000-02) survives only in the Wayback Machine; it states no edition, but its biblical apparatus follows Fontes Franciscani (1995). Free in practice, edition unverified.
